title: Why Are the Fishing Boats in Câmara de Lobos So Colourful?
description: Mostly tradition and the owner's taste. No law sets the colours: EU rules only fix the black and white marks on the bow. What xavelhas are, and the best view.
heroAlt: Painted fishing boats on dark pebbles and in the water at Câmara de Lobos, seen from directly above
keywords: why are the fishing boats in camara de lobos so colourful
camara de lobos from the sea
